depicted.setting: Outdoor entrance apron of a small pressure habitat on rocky Mars terrain
depicted.scale: Close building entrance, hatch and damaged vestibule are human-scale; foreground rocks and adjoining fixed ice/melt station are near the camera; distant canyon ridges beyond.
depicted.viewpoint: Outside, slightly raised three-quarter view toward the habitat front and right side; inner closed hatch is visible through ripped outer vestibule.
depicted.state: Intact curved pressure cabin, closed inner hatch, visibly torn outer vestibule with large open gaps and exposed frame; no completed repair.

features.name: Open sky, low sun and distant layered ridges

features.name: Fixed connected sealed melt unit

features.name: Tall fixed signal mast

features.name: Rocky entrance apron and foreground
